description: A version-2 scene shot: a self-contained 3D world-object shot that scene.add / scene.update materializes into an ordinary component clip. The shot owns its layers, camera, lighting, backdrop and normalized local animation; the composition owns start, duration, ordering, cuts and transitions. World coordinates are REFERENCE PIXELS: origin at frame centre, +X right, +Y up, +Z toward the viewer. World rotations, camera fov and laptop openAngle are radians. referenceSize must have the SAME aspect ratio as the composition format; mismatch fails instead of cropping. At equal aspect ratio the shot scales uniformly by outputWidth/referenceWidth. A segment's easing belongs to the keyframe it ARRIVES at; the first keyframe has no easing. Authoring limits: 32 layers, 4 devices, 16 distinct image slots, 256 keyframes per channel, 2048 keyframes per shot. Version 2 supports nested groups, procedural slab/page/phone/laptop objects and owned static GLB models with bounded embedded PNG/JPEG textures (static-glb-untextured-v1 or static-glb-textured-v1; model-level transforms and digest-scoped scalar material edits), screen- and world-space text, admitted image/component/video surfaces, fixed photographic, generated studio and owned RGBE 1024x512 environment data assets (up to 8 MiB encoded; intensity 0–100 and rotation ±2π radians), transparent/solid/linear/radial backdrops, constraints, focus, bounded display-linear-bloom-v1 before grain/vignette, measured single-camera half-float/MSAA4 physical transmission, and opaque stateless-fragment-display-linear-v1 mesh.shader fields. mesh.shader owns vec3 field(vec2 uv, vec3 localPosition), at most32 finite typed uniforms and4 owned PNG/JPEG image samplers, deterministic cfFrame/cfRate/cfTime/cfSeed/cfResolution inputs; source is parsed and locally compiled/drawn before first playback or exact frame. It requires non-instanced UV geometry and effective world opacity1. Raw HTML, arbitrary custom shader props or full GLSL, loops/recursion/macros/extensions/derivatives/scene sampling/feedback/depth writes, animated/compressed/skeletal GLB profiles, subnode editing, arbitrary external HDR environments, skeletal animation and physics are refused with an exact field path.
